name: Selma
source:
A senior member of the Demon Lord's army. Dark elf.
A cool, intelligent beauty who devotes herself entirely to the study of magic and alchemy.
She also has a haughty side, thinking that everyone other than herself is research material.
She is a member of the Demon King's Army because she can obtain an environment for her research.
Because she is too intelligent, she considers biological and animal life to be inferior.
